_about: Public-domain John Gorham Palfrey (1796-1881), Unitarian minister of Brattle Street Church, Boston, Dexter Professor of Sacred Literature at Harvard and later historian of New England, for the Word Hoard: his religious works: Sermons on Duties belonging to the Conditions of Private Life (1834), Academical Lectures on the Jewish Scriptures and Antiquities (vols. 1-2, 1838-1840), Lowell Lectures on the Evidences of Christianity (2 vols., 1843) and The Relation between Judaism and Christianity (1854). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 78 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

palfrey-sermons-duties: Sermons on duties belonging to some of the conditions and relations of private life (Boston, Charles Bowen, 1834)

_excluded.palfrey-history: his History of New England and political papers (Papers on the Slave Power) are history and politics, not theology; Harmony of the Gospels is Lant Carpenter's
